prompt: A cinematic film still captures a bustling mountain campsite at twilight. On the left, a man in a red scarf sits on a wooden log while holding a steaming mug. Next to him stands a tall woman in a blue coat who is pointing toward the distant peaks. A brown dog rests its head on her boot, looking up expectantly. In the center, a large orange tent dominates the foreground, with its flap partially open. A child in a yellow raincoat crawls out of the tent opening, reaching for a shiny flashlight lying on the grass. Beside the child, a black cat watches intently from atop a stacked pile of firewood. To the right of the tent, an older man in a gray hat tends to a crackling campfire, using a long metal poker to adjust the logs. A silver kettle hangs over the flames, emitting a thin wisp of steam. Standing behind the older man is a teenager in a green hoodie, handing a marshmallow stick to a girl in a pink beanie. The girl in the pink beanie smiles as she takes the stick, standing next to a folded camping chair. Near the chair, a backpack with reflective strips leans against a tree trunk. Above them, a string of fairy lights glows softly between two pine trees. A hawk circles high in the sky, visible as a small silhouette against the fading light. On the far right edge, a ranger in a tan uniform observes the group from a distance, holding a clipboard. A pair of hiking boots lies abandoned near the ranger’s feet. The ground is covered in pine needles and small stones. There is no snow on the ground. There is no vehicle visible in the frame. There is no modern electronic device other than the flashlight.
